policy.label: Policy P4.1: Delivery times by country
policy.text:
Every order travels with Courierline, tracked, and needs a signature on delivery. Delivery times are counted in business days from dispatch.

Australia, metro (capital cities and major centres such as Geelong, Newcastle and the Gold Coast): 1 to 3 business days. Australia, regional and remote: 3 to 6 business days.

The ETA shown on an order is the last day of this window. An order is not late until the ETA has passed. Tracking numbers start with CD, and the tracking link is in the dispatch email. We can only deliver within the country where the prescription was issued.

policy.label: Policy P3.1: Prescriptions, dispensing and dispatch
policy.text:
Order statuses. Script pending: a clinician is approving a new prescription and sending it to our partner pharmacy. This usually takes up to 2 business days after the consult. Dispensing: the pharmacist checks and packs the order, usually within 1 business day. Shipped: the order is with Courierline and has a tracking number. Delivered: Courierline has recorded the delivery.

Repeat orders on an existing prescription skip script pending. They are placed on the billing date and go straight to dispensing. Orders dispensed by 2 pm local time are dispatched the same business day; otherwise the next business day. Orders placed on a weekend are processed on the next business day. So a repeat order is usually dispatched 1 to 2 business days after the billing date.

Agents cannot speed up a prescription approval or add products to an order. They can check the status, explain it, and pass a request to a clinician.

policy.label: Policy P5.3: Refunds and shipping fees
policy.text:
Refunds go back to the original card and take 5 to 10 business days to appear. Prescription medicines cannot be returned or resold, so we cannot refund a change of mind once an order has been dispensed. If a plan is cancelled or paused before the order is dispensed, the charge for that order is refunded in full. For a lost or damaged order we reship by default, or refund if the patient prefers. Refunds over A$250, NZ$270 or £150 need team lead approval.

Shipping fees. Plan orders ship free. Replacements for lost, damaged or wrong orders ship free. The one-off shipping fee (A$12, NZ$14 or £6.50) applies to sending again a parcel that was returned to the pharmacy after a missed delivery. If an order that carried a shipping fee arrives 2 or more business days after its ETA, we refund the shipping fee.
